subject: Urgent: Expiring Security Certificate on Your Account
body: Dear valued client, I am writing to bring to your attention a matter of utmost importance regarding the security of your account with YourBank. Our system has alerted us that the security certificate associated with your account is set to expire within the next 48 hours. This certificate is crucial for ensuring the encryption and protection of your sensitive financial information. If this certificate expires, your account will be temporarily suspended, and you will not be able to access your funds or conduct any transactions until the issue is resolved. To avoid any inconvenience, we strongly advise you to take immediate action. We recommend that you contact our dedicated Fraud Hotline at +1-800-555-1234 to speak with one of our security specialists. They will guide you through the process of renewing your security certificate and ensure that your account remains secure. Please have your account information ready when you call, as this will expedite the verification process. Our team is available 24/7 to assist you, and we urge you to call as soon as possible to prevent any disruption to your account services. Your prompt attention to this matter is greatly appreciated, and we look forward to resolving this issue swiftly. Sincerely, A Wealth Management Advisor support@your-bank-portal.com You can review the details here: https://it-helpdesk.example.com/doc/fe70c368

body: Dear all, I am new to R and statistics really in general. I am hoping that someone will be able to point me in the right direction and/or suggest a technique/package/reference that will help me with the following. I have: Some input variables (integers, real) Some output variables (integers, real) and I want to find out which between the two correlate best - i.e. the salient features.
